overview.text: In a candidate questionnaire, Talavera said Lawndale should meet its legal housing responsibilities but decide where new development belongs, insist on quality development, and protect current residents. He called for new housing to include homes affordable to working families, seniors, and young adults. He argued for a balanced approach that does not rely exclusively on taxes, development, or budget cuts. He proposed a resident-driven five-year plan with five measurable goals, building city reserves for emergencies and infrastructure, and revitalizing Hawthorne Boulevard to fill vacant storefronts and support local businesses.
